bullets.text: The Supreme Court ordered the demolition of 20 houses in Thiruvallur after cancelling pattas on waterbody land, requiring the office to monitor relief.
Anbumani Ramadoss urged the Tamil Nadu government to notify the Pallikaranai marshland and release an integrated management plan, which the office should watch.
Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay jointly opened CapitaLand's first data centre in Chennai, highlighting economic ties.

stories.title: நீர்நிலை நிலத்தின் பட்டா ரத்து: திருவள்ளூரில் 20 குடியிருப்புகளை இடிக்கவும் உச்ச நீதிமன்றம் உத்தரவு
takeaways: The Supreme Court ordered the demolition of twenty residential units on water body lands in Thiruvallur.
The district administration must enforce the court directive and provide alternative resettlement sites.

takeaways: PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss demanded an immediate integrated management plan for the Pallikaranai marshland.
The state government faces pressure to protect the ecologically sensitive wetland area located within Velachery constituency.

stories.title: Singapore DPM Gan Kim Yong, Tamil Nadu CM Vijay Open CapitaLand’s First Chennai Data Centre
takeaways: Singapore DPM Gan Kim Yong and CM C Joseph Vijay unveiled CapitaLand's first data centre in Chennai.
The high-profile inauguration strengthens bilateral economic ties and expands Tamil Nadu digital infrastructure.
